cards.audioTextZh: 你能在这张图片中看到什么？

cards.audioText: How can ice on a wing affect flight safety?
cards.audioTextZh: 机翼结冰会如何影响飞行安全？
cards.referenceText: Ice changes the shape and surface of the wing. It reduces lift, increases drag, and may raise the stall speed. It can also reduce control effectiveness, so even a small amount of contamination may create a serious safety risk.
cards.referenceTextZh: 结冰会改变机翼的形状和表面状态。它会减小升力、增大阻力，还可能提高失速速度。结冰也会降低操纵效能，因此即使只有少量污染物，也可能造成严重的安全风险。

cards.audioText: What should a pilot do if ice or frost is found on the wings before departure?
cards.audioTextZh: 起飞前如果发现机翼上有冰或霜，飞行员应如何处置？
cards.referenceText: The pilot should not depart until the wings and other required critical surfaces are clean. Existing ice or frost must first be removed by an approved deicing process; anti-icing treatment may then be applied when needed to delay new contamination. The crew should follow the applicable procedure, consider holdover time and repeat the inspection if conditions require it.
cards.referenceTextZh: 在机翼和其他规定的关键表面清洁之前，飞行员不应起飞。已有的冰或霜必须先通过经批准的除冰程序清除；必要时还可以进行防冰处理，以延缓新的污染物形成。机组应遵循适用程序，考虑防冰保持时间，并在条件需要时重新检查。
